# Little Kit

## Overview

- **Age:** Infant (born in Volume 4)  <sub>[v4 c19 P1](../source/v04-c19.md#nw-v04-c19-p0001), [v4 c19 P6](../source/v04-c19.md#nw-v04-c19-p0006)</sub>
- **Gender:** Male  <sub>[v4 c19 P1](../source/v04-c19.md#nw-v04-c19-p0001), [v4 c19 P6](../source/v04-c19.md#nw-v04-c19-p0006)</sub>
- **Status:** Alive  <sub>[v5 c3 P7](../source/v05-c03.md#nw-v05-c03-p0007)</sub>
- **Origin:** Seven Gulls Harbor, St. Brendan's Island  <sub>[v4 c5 P2](../source/v04-c05.md#nw-v04-c05-p0002), [v4 c19 P1](../source/v04-c19.md#nw-v04-c19-p0001)</sub>
- **Nicknames:** Kit; Little Kit  <sub>[v4 c22 P2](../source/v04-c22.md#nw-v04-c22-p0002)</sub>

## Appearance

As a newborn, he weighed ten pounds, possessed lung power, and had soft fuzz on his head that was predicted to be red, though his father preferred to see it as hazel like his own. He has a forehead identical to his father's, and his small ears are perfectly shaped, sitting flat against his head. By his second year, he is described as a plump, chubby child with red, curly hair and hazel eyes that crinkle shut when he falls asleep.

_Sources: [v4 c19 P6](../source/v04-c19.md#nw-v04-c19-p0006), [v4 c21 P14](../source/v04-c21.md#nw-v04-c21-p0014), [v4 c22 P16](../source/v04-c22.md#nw-v04-c22-p0016), [v5 c1 P2](../source/v05-c01.md#nw-v05-c01-p0002)_

## History

Little Kit was born at the small house of dreams in Seven Gulls Harbor in the month of June. His birth brought immense healing and comfort to his mother, Nell, following the loss of her firstborn daughter the previous year. He was named James Obed Carrow after Captain Saul Garrick and Obed Abernethy. During his infancy, he was doted on by his family and neighbors, including Captain Saul, who bequeathed his collection of sea curiosities to him. As a young child, he remained closely cared for by his mother and Tabitha Pratt.

_Sources: [v4 c17 P27](../source/v04-c17.md#nw-v04-c17-p0027), [v4 c19 P1](../source/v04-c19.md#nw-v04-c19-p0001), [v4 c19 P12](../source/v04-c19.md#nw-v04-c19-p0012), [v4 c21 P35](../source/v04-c21.md#nw-v04-c21-p0035), [v4 c22 P9](../source/v04-c22.md#nw-v04-c22-p0009), [v5 c1 P2](../source/v05-c01.md#nw-v05-c01-p0002)_
